definitions.explanation: Drops of liquid from the eyes when crying.

examples.japanese: {嬉|うれ}しくて{涙|なみだ}が{止|と}まらなかった。
examples.english: I was so happy that I couldn't stop crying.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}を{見|み}ていたら、{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}てしまった。
examples.english: I ended up crying while watching the movie.

examples.japanese: {悲|かな}しいニュースを{聞|き}いて{涙|なみだ}を{流|なが}している{人|ひと}が{大勢|おおぜい}いた。
examples.english: Many people were in tears after hearing the sad news.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}で{先生|せんせい}や{友達|ともだち}との{別|わか}れが{辛|つら}くて、{泣|な}くまいと{思|おも}っていたのに{涙|なみだ}が{止|と}まらなかった。
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, saying goodbye to teachers and friends was so hard that I couldn't hold back my tears even though I tried not to cry.

notes:
{涙|なみだ} means tears—the liquid that flows from the eyes when crying or due to irritation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {涙|なみだ}を{流|なが}す: to shed tears
- {涙|なみだ}が{出|で}る: tears come out
- {涙|なみだ}が{止|と}まらない: can't stop crying
- {涙|なみだ}もろい: easily moved to tears
- {涙|なみだ}を{拭|ふ}く: to wipe away tears

TYPES OF TEARS:
- {嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}: tears of joy
- {悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}: tears of frustration

COMPOUNDS:
- {涙声|なみだごえ}: tearful voice
- {涙目|なみだめ}: teary eyes
- {涙腺|るいせん}: tear glands (lacrimal glands)
